text:
zoe: heads-up - we're getting a low-volume but persistent stream of fncall schema rejects on route cache.tool-invoke in us-west after the strict-schema flip. rejects are mostly type-mismatches (string vs object) and missing optional objects. anyone digging in?

rahul: on it. looks correlated with adapter `fast-cache-v1` change that returned compact keys instead of full objects. sample log: {error:EVAL_307, path:response.entries[0], expected:object, got:string} 

evan: options: 1) rollback strict guard (slow) 2) enable routeOverride -> permissive variant 3) add per-route soft-coerce that synthesizes minimal object + emits `validation.warnings` and `validation.provenance`.

zoe: prefer soft-coerce for canary slice, but we need clear telemetry and billing rules before rolling wide. we must not silently charge customers for platform corrections.

console-bot: console asks: show a per-route mitigation banner when soft-coerce or permissive variant is active, include a small "coercions/min" stat on route row, and provide an inspector diff (before/after) for sampled requests.

ops-bot: Alert: validation.reject rate 0.34% on cache.tool-invoke (us-west)  incident INC-8240 opened.

rahul: proposed runtime flag payload: 
```
route_override:
  route: cache.tool-invoke
  when: validation.rejects.rate > 0.003
  action: enable_mode
  mode: soft-coerce
  telemetry_tags: ["validation.soft_coerce","canary:5pct"]
  billing_tag: billing_review
  sample_rate: 200
```

platform-qa: test ask: we need CI fuzz tests that inject string/object/null permutations and assert both strict and soft-coerce modes behave as expected. add tests to adapter harness and the validator integration suite.

billing: policy note: finance prefers marking affected requests as `billing_review` and producing a daily CSV for manual adjustment. full unbillable only after review. automated unbillable flag ok for short emergency window (<4h) with ops approval.

evan: telemetry detail: include metrics `validation.mode`, `coercion_count`, `validation.warnings` (counter), and dimension `adapter_name` + `route_variant`. also emit a header `X-Validation-Provenance` with comma-separated coerced paths for traced requests.

zoe: love the provenance header but make it opt-in via sampling to avoid PII leakage. add redact rules for payload sampling.

rahul: implementing hotfix: enable soft-coerce on canary 5% with billing_review tag and 200 sampled payloads/hr to secure bucket s3://redwood-debug/usw/1891112223/ for 72h. PR #5002.

ops-bot: Update: PR #5002 deployed to canary at 09:05 UTC. reject rate dropped ~68% in 10m. keeping alert open.

console-bot: deploying a quick banner: "Soft-coerce active on cache.tool-invoke (canary 5%). Affected requests tagged billing_review. Click for details." also added a dashboard tile correlating `coercion_count` with `adapter_name`.

platform-qa: opened PR for CI fuzz tests and a small harness that asserts provenance header shows coerced paths. linking to PR #5010.

billing: created ticket BILL-172 to track daily CSV exports and the manual adjustment workflow.

zoe: action items: 1) rahul - monitor and escalate if reject rate >1% 2) evan - add provenance header sampling + redact rules 3) console - keep banner until we patch adapters 4) platform-qa - land CI tests. we'll reconvene in 45m. :thumbsup:
